meta.homeTitle: TabNow: every tab, one keystroke away
meta.homeDescription: TabNow is a fast fuzzy finder for your open tabs. Press Ctrl+E, type a few letters, hit Enter. Searches every window, private by design, open source.
meta.ogAlt: TabNow, a fuzzy finder for your open browser tabs

install.soon: Coming soon to the Chrome Web Store

hero.subtitle: A fuzzy finder for your open tabs. Press Ctrl+E, type a few letters, hit Enter.

demo.label: Live demo of the TabNow finder

features.label: Features
features.lead: TabNow is a small Chrome extension. No windows to sort, no tab groups to keep tidy.

items.title: Find any tab in a keystroke
items.text: Ctrl+E, a few letters, Enter. The previous tab is preselected, so Ctrl+E Enter flips back.

items.title: Fast and fuzzy
items.text: Type "gh pr" and get the GitHub pull request. Domain ranks above title, title above the rest of the address.

items.title: Keyboard first
items.text: Arrows or Ctrl+J / Ctrl+K to move, Ctrl+Backspace to close a tab. The mouse works too.

items.title: Every window
items.text: All open windows in one list. Bookmarks and history join in when you turn them on, with /b and /h.

items.title: Private by design
items.text: No network requests, no account, no analytics. Nothing leaves your browser.

items.title: Fits your browser
items.text: Light and dark, adjustable opacity, blur and size. Alt+Z jumps to the previous tab without opening anything.

themes.label: Themes
themes.lead: TabNow follows your system, or you pick. <kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> switches on the spot. Try the same three options you get on the options page.
themes.opacityHint: Lower lets the page show through.
themes.sizeHint: Makes the search box and its text bigger or smaller.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.lead: No account, no analytics, no servers. About 600 lines of plain JavaScript with no dependencies, open source under MIT. Here is what it asks the browser for, and why.

perms.name: tabs
perms.text: Read titles and addresses of open tabs, so you can search them.

perms.name: activeTab
perms.text: Show the finder on the page you are on.

perms.name: scripting
perms.text: Put the finder on that page.

perms.name: storage
perms.text: Remember your settings on this device.

perms.name: bookmarks
perms.text: Only if you turn on /b. The browser asks first.

perms.name: history
perms.text: Only if you turn on /h. Last 90 days, searched locally.

installSection.label: Install
installSection.lead: Works in Chrome 121+, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Arc.
installSection.leadSoon: Works in Chrome 121+, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Arc. Not in the Web Store yet.
steps: Open TabNow in the Chrome Web Store.
Press Ctrl+E on any page. Change the key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

llms.tagline: A fuzzy finder for your open tabs.
